description: Segregation of Duties conflict matrix. Each entry defines a pair of permissions that must not coexist for the same user.

conflicts.rationale: A user who can approve payments must not also create purchase orders - this enables fraudulent self-approval of transactions.
A user who can approve payments must not manage user accounts - risk of creating ghost users to redirect payments.
A user who can delete accounts must not also read audit logs - risk of covering tracks after unauthorized deletions.
Classic four-eyes principle violation: the requestor of a purchase order must not be its own approver.
System administrators must not have financial approval rights - separation between IT and Finance controls.
